monster:baby green dragon.visualDescription: A compact dragon crouches with a dark blue head, green back and flank, small raised wing, and curled tail.
monster:baby green dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a juvenile green dragon associated with poison; it bites but has not yet gained the adult breath attack.
monster:baby green dragon.modelBrief: Sculpt a young four-legged dragon with a short neck, small folded wing, and curled tail; keep the blue-black head and vivid green body. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:baby yellow dragon.visualDescription: This small crouched dragon has an orange head and neck, bright yellow wing and body, and a dark curled tail base.
monster:baby yellow dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a juvenile yellow dragon associated with acid; its young form attacks by biting.
monster:baby yellow dragon.modelBrief: Reuse the juvenile dragon proportions with a broad yellow wing, orange face, and dark belly and tail base. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:gray dragon.visualDescription: A tall rearing dragon has a near-black torso, gray-blue wings, long neck, and coiled tail.
monster:gray dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an adult dragon of magic whose breath is magic missiles and whose body has a bite and two claws.
monster:gray dragon.modelBrief: Build the shared adult rearing dragon with broad angular wings and a curled tail, then apply muted gray-blue wings against a very dark body. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:gold dragon.visualDescription: A rearing dragon shows bronze-brown limbs and tail, a bright golden wing, and pale cream face highlights.
monster:gold dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a NetHack 5 adult gold dragon associated with light and fire breath.
monster:gold dragon.modelBrief: Keep the adult dragon silhouette, with warm ivory-gold wing and face highlights over a bronze body. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:silver dragon.visualDescription: A dark-bodied rearing dragon has pale silver wing surfaces, white rim highlights, and a curled tail.
monster:silver dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an adult silver dragon whose cold breath and reflective scales distinguish it from other dragons.
monster:silver dragon.modelBrief: Use the common adult dragon shape with cool metallic wing membranes and crisp white glints while retaining the dark torso. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:shimmering dragon.visualDescription: A dark rearing dragon carries bright cyan-blue wings, pale cyan edging, and a curled tail.
monster:shimmering dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki documents the shimmering dragon as a deferred NetHack monster intended to have displacement and a magic missile breath.
monster:shimmering dragon.modelBrief: Model the normal adult dragon anatomy with blue-white iridescent wings and restrained shifting highlights; do not invent a second body offset as solid anatomy. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:red dragon.visualDescription: A rearing dragon combines a dark crimson body, saturated pink-red wings, and a bright red curled tail.
monster:red dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies an adult fire dragon with fire breath, a bite, and claws.
monster:red dragon.modelBrief: Give the adult dragon broad scarlet wing membranes and a hot red tail while preserving the black-red central silhouette. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:white dragon.visualDescription: A near-black rearing dragon has pale peach-white wings, light gray edging, and a dark coiled tail.
monster:white dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an adult dragon associated with cold that breathes freezing air.
monster:white dragon.modelBrief: Use the standard adult frame with frosty white wing surfaces and cool dark limbs; avoid turning the warm sprite highlights into open flame. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:orange dragon.visualDescription: A red-brown rearing dragon bears an orange-yellow wing, bright orange tail, and dark chest.
monster:orange dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies an adult orange dragon whose breath puts targets to sleep.
monster:orange dragon.modelBrief: Preserve the adult wing and curled tail forms, using orange and amber membranes over a dark reddish body without adding fire effects. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:black dragon.visualDescription: A heavy near-black dragon rears with charcoal wing panels, dark claws, and a thick curled tail.
monster:black dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an adult black dragon whose breath disintegrates targets.
monster:black dragon.modelBrief: Use the same dragon anatomy with layered charcoal and muted purple-black surfaces; keep highlights subtle so the wing edge remains legible. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:blue dragon.visualDescription: This rearing dragon has cobalt-blue wings and tail over a dark indigo body, with pale cyan on the wing.
monster:blue dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki associates adult blue dragons with lightning breath.
monster:blue dragon.modelBrief: Build the adult silhouette in saturated indigo and electric blue, keeping the cyan areas as wing highlights rather than constant lightning bolts. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:green dragon.visualDescription: A dark rearing dragon has mint-green wings, emerald tail markings, and a near-black neck and chest.
monster:green dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the adult green dragon with poison breath and poison resistance.
monster:green dragon.modelBrief: Use the adult dragon form, mint wing membranes, emerald scales, and a dark central mass; make the tail curl match the tile. The paired atlas slots can share this design.
